mutant.positive_control: PAIRED POSITIVE CONTROL, because a refusal alone cannot distinguish 'the checker caught the mutation' from 'the input was invalid anyway': the consumer run against the REAL certified artifact, read at its pin rather than from a working tree -> exit 0, ADMITTED-ON-CONTROL, sec-6.3 frames read from prd_6_3 with denominators 1,941 / 1,820 and predicates typed FALSE on both. determinism.description: The harness rebuilds its throwaway git repo from scratch on every run, so every pin, ancestry test and blob digest is re-derived rather than cached.
determinism.method: python tail_harness.py re-run after each binding edit; the repo is deleted and re-created per run, so no pin or digest is carried over.
determinism.expected: Repeated runs return the same 39 of 39.
determinism.observed: Re-run after each binding edit; 39 of 39 each time.

declared_exclusions.item: Any re-emission, edit or re-certification of the fused artifact.
declared_exclusions.reason: It is certified and immutable; the two items this face carries against it (no split-half declaration, scheme in prose) are raised to its owner and typed forward by Addendum 1e, not repaired here.

declared_exclusions.item: Any L4 persistence test, and any claim on PRD 6.1, 6.2 or 6.5.
declared_exclusions.reason: Wave 2 emits L4-C02's census INPUT and runs no L4 test. A completion claim naming 6.1, 6.2 or 6.5 as PASSED would be FALSE, and the census artifact says so in its own claims_no_l4_result field.

declared_exclusions.item: Any derived floor for either statistic.
declared_exclusions.reason: Addendum 1b forbids same-run derivation: run 1 emits the battery as EVIDENCE at HELD-UNEXERCISED with no floor_derivation block. The derivation belongs to the consuming run.

surprises: 1c's REFUSAL 'null != mean(draws)' IS UNIMPLEMENTABLE AS EXACT EQUALITY AND WOULD HAVE REFUSED THE VERY ARTIFACT 1d COMMISSIONS. rho declares null -0.016284 while the mean of its own six 6-decimal draws is -0.0162841666...; J declares 0.055561 against 0.0555611666... A 1e-9 test refuses both, and a fixed 1e-6 is too tight for a 4-decimal artifact and too loose for a 12-decimal one. Found by transcribing 1d's PUBLISHED numbers into the harness rather than my own. Raised; Addendum 1e struck the exact-equality wording and adopted the precision-derived tolerance as written.

n_permutations WAS AT THE WRONG GRAIN: 1a placed it at the floor_derivation level, one value for both statistics, while 1d item 2 lets rho (N>=5) and J (N>=20) diverge. One level-wide value cannot represent that derivation. Raised; 1e item 2 moved it per statistic and superseded 1a's field.

1a's CANONICAL FIELD LIST NAMED NO ARTIFACT PATH while 1c bound the two carriers as one contract -- and a pin without a path does not address a block, so the check was structurally unrunnable. Raised; 1e item 3 added derived_from_path.

THE ARTIFACT CARRIES NO SPLIT-HALF DECLARATION, and it is in neither design read's instrument list. L3-C01 sec 1 requires DISJOINT halves of a named battery; b6 records '2 split-halves' and a seed policy but never which runs form the halves, so disjointness is unfalsifiable on the artifact. OBSERVATION, not BLOCKING -- admission rests on the fired control. 1e (A) types the block from run 2.

MY OWN CONSUMER HAD INVENTED THREE JSON SLOT NAMES the producer never agreed to -- split_half, output_domain_pairs, sec_6_3_frames -- because it was written from the declaration's PROSE. Every substantive arm was right and every path assumption was wrong; the substance was at output_domain.pairs and prd_6_3 all along. No amount of re-reading my own file would have shown it. The declaration fixes substance; it fixes no keys.

I REPORTED A GATE CONDITION THAT DOES NOT EXIST. I had been stating these four cells as gated on the fused artifact AND a 'third-gate receipt'. 2.0.0_SA_COO~X disagreed rather than repeating the GO; measured at source, neither the RE-SCOPE that seated me nor 3.0.0_SA_CVO~X's ACK of it contains that phrase or any second condition. It was my own paraphrase read back as a gate, and had the issuer simply re-asserted, I would have complied against a gate I invented.
